description: This file defines the AdminReviewMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It implements menu configuration logic for the HRM system, specifically overriding the screen for performance review search functionality.

classes.name: AdminReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the admin review section, overriding specific screens based on module context.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the getCurrentModuleAndScreen method to set the screen to 'searchEvaluatePerformanceReview' for the current module, and returns null.
